MIND. [1] [Crot. t.]
Not disposed to work.
Feeling of anxiety, as though some personal misfortune would befall him.
Morose, dissatisfied.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Crot. t.]
Dulness, heaviness, or confusion of head.
Dizziness and faintness, < in open air, with drowsiness, nausea, pale complexion, exhaustion and diarrhœa.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Crot. t.]
Sensitiveness of head ; weight of hat causes headache.
Heat and heaviness in head, soreness in eyeballs when turning eyes ; bad taste in mouth, feels clammy and nasty ; thirst ; weak, faint spells ; flushes of heat.
Headache worse in morning.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Crot. t.]
Sensitiveness of head to pressure of hat.
Boring of head into pillow ; fontanelles sunken. θ Cholera infantum.
Crusta lactea.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Crot. t.]
Opacity of cornea.
Keratitis pustulosa : with much eruption on lids and face ; with excessive photophobia.
Ulceration of conjunctiva, contraction of pupil, profuse lachrymation and dimness of cornea.
Conjunctivitis pustulosa, eyes feel hot and burning, especially at night ; face red and burning ; feverish ; marked photophobia, ciliary injection, with considerable pain in and around eye, usually worse at night.
Pustules terminating in ulcers and ulceration of cornea, with much pain in supra-ciliary region and eruption on face ; much pain in eye, whenever a movement from bowels occurred.
Iritis with pustular eruption on face.
Irritation and inflammatory redness of conjunctiva.
Violent ophthalmia ; on second day, ulceration of conjunctiva over cornea and sclera, irritation of sclera and iris ; contraction of pupil ; injected state of vessels of conjunctiva, sclera and eyelids, profuse lachrymation, photophobia, violent pains disturbing night's rest ; burning and violent pain of eye.
Pain which seemed to extend from pupil of left eye to back part of head. θ Neuralgia.
Sensation as of a string pulling eyeball back into head.
Stinging in eyeball.
Soreness in eyeballs when turning eyes.
Burning pain in inflamed eye, with burning in ear, vertigo and fainting.
Itching of eyelids.
Œdematous swelling of eyelids (eyelids look puffed).
Twitching of eyelids.
Copious lachrymation.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Crot. t.]
Spasmodic twinging pains, deep within left ear.
Deafness.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Crot. t.]
Burning in nostrils ; inflamed nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Crot. t.]
Sensation as though insects were creeping on face.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Crot. t.]
Lips dry and parched. θ Cholera infantum.
Burning of lips.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Crot. t.]
Bad taste in mouth, clammy and nasty.
Sensitiveness of tip of tongue.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Crot. t.]
Painful swelling of submaxillary glands and tonsils.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Crot. t.]
General irritation in fauces, redness, swelling and elongation of uvula.
Constrictive sensation in throat.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Crot. t.]
Constant thirst.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Crot. t.]
Excessive nausea, with vanishing of sight, sweat on forehead, distension of abdomen, excessive gagging, vertigo, < after drinking, with frequent discharge of greenish or yellowish water from bowels.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Crot. t.]
Sinking in stomach, with sensation of weakness.
Sensation of emptiness in stomach.
Burning in stomach.
Sensitiveness of region of stomach to touch.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Crot. t.]
Abdomen distended ; coldness.
Unpleasant sensation of emptiness and hunger ; rumbling in abdomen.
Extreme coldness, amounting to chilliness along spinal column downward and through entire abdomen, with nausea and vomiting, subsequently flushed feeling in head and face, with writhing pain, commencing in region of transverse colon and gradually extending downward through whole intestinal canal ; very copious pap-like and watery discharges, generally of light grey color, but varying ; slight tenesmus, anxious countenance, depression of spirits, great restlessness. θ Diarrhœa.
Colicky pain in transverse colon before every stool.
Griping colic and writhing around umbilicus.
Abdomen full and distended, griping pain about navel.
Bearing down in abdomen, as if everything was relaxed.
On pressing on umbilicus with hand, painful sensation is felt all along intestinal canal to termination of rectum, causing latter to protrude.
Colic > from hot milk.
Gurgling in intestines, as though nothing but water was in them, mostly on left side.
Swashing in intestines as from water.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Crot. t.]
Flatulence, soon followed by urgent desire for stool.
Evacuation sudden, and with much flatus.
Stools occur suddenly, one gush and it is finished, great prostration after a passage. θ Cholera infantum.
Constant urging to stool, followed by sudden, pasty evacuation, which is shot out of rectum, of a dirty green color and offensive.
Watery, yellow, at times slightly green passages, passed in a single gush ; each stool seems to "drain child dry", but notwithstanding, very little prostration, passages every half hour, from 8 A. M. till evening, none at night.
Pasty, light brown stool covered with mucus, with frequent urging, followed by rumbling, gurgling in left side of abdomen.
Stool : dark green ; tenacious, mucous ; watery, mixed with whitish flakes ; watery, painless ; coming out like a shot ; < from drink and food.
Stools preceded by colic and borborygmus ; during stool cutting in abdomen with sensitiveness ; after stool, burning in anus ; greatest prostration, patient even fainting ; coldness of body ; dizziness ; face sunken and altered in expression. θ Cholerine.
Vomiting and diarrhœa after taking least nourishment ; stools profuse, watery, yellow and at times yellowish-green ; stool passed with a single gush ; has about twenty-five stools during day, none at night ; extreme prostration and emaciation ; symptoms of hydrocephaloid already developed ; boring of head in pillow ; fontanelles sunken ; body and extremities cool ; convulsions. θ Cholera infantum.
Diarrhœa coming on suddenly ; pain in abdomen, faint feeling before, during and after stool ; sweat on face after stool.
Diarrheic attack during night, very copious fecal evacuations, gradually losing their natural color and consistence with each successive stool ; swashing feeling and sound in abdomen ; great apprehension of a serious termination. θ Diarrhœa.
Every movement of body renews discharges, producing at first very violent pain in bowels with tenesmus ; discharges frequent and small.
Diarrheic stool accompanied by sweat, tenesmus, or with nausea and colic.
Diarrhœa : worse after drinking ; while nursing ; while eating ; during Summer ; from fruit and sweetmeats.
Upon pressure at umbilicus, a painful sensation is felt down to anus, where there is constant pressure outward.
Dragging in anus, as if diarrhœa would easily ensue.
Burning in anus.
Pain in anus, as if a plug was forcing outward.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Crot. t.]
Frequent corrosive itching on glans and scrotum.
Scrotum shrivelled, itching severely, disturbing sleep ; > from scratching, which however, causes a voluptuous sensation.
Corrosive itching pain on scrotum, < while walking ; redness of part.
Vesicular eruption on scrotum and penis.
Eczema of scrotum, itching excessively, < at night.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Crot. t.]
Intense itching of genitals, > by very gentle scratching.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Crot. t.]
Inflamed, hard, swollen breasts, threatening to gather ; pain from nipple through to back.
Nipple very sore to touch, excruciating pain running from nipple through to scapula of same side, when child nurses.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Crot. t.]
Complete loss of voice after drinking cold water while overheated.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Crot. t.]
Feels as though he could not expand lungs.
Tightness of chest and inability to make a deep inspiration and inhale as much air as usual. θ Cold.
Asthma with cough, causing drawing pain through left pectoral region into back.
Sense of suffocation, compelling him to jump out of bed and sleep in a chair. θ Cough.
   

COUGH. [27] [Crot. t.]
Obstinate cough, < at night when lying in bed, compelling her to jump out of bed and walk about, on account of sense of suffocation ; is compelled to lie in bed in a partly sitting posture, for fear of suffocation.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Crot. t.]
Feeling of fulness in both sides of chest, with burning stitches in left side of thorax and towards both scapulæ.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Crot. t.]
Tearing, shooting pain in left arm, from shoulder to elbow and back of hand, with swelling of shoulder and whole arm ; inability to move the limb or lie down ; < at night, preventing sleep, but if rest be obtained, he awakes relieved, but least attempt to stir causes pain to reappear with great violence ; arm becomes paralyzed and feels like a very heavy weight. θ Brachial neuralgia.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Crot. t.]
Pain in soles of feet spreading towards great toe, with sensation as if it had been sprained ; < in afternoons and from touch ; veins on dorsum of foot swollen ; between swollen veins, red patches which do not disappear on pressure. θ Rheumatism.
   

NERVES. [36] [Crot. t.]
Very great debility.
Weak, faint spells, with flushes of heat.
   

FEVER. [40] [Crot. t.]
Coldness of feet, extending as far up as calves.
Great coldness and chilliness along spinal column and through whole body ; nausea and vomiting, followed by flying heat in head and face. θ Diarrhœa.
Flushes of heat.
Heat and fever accompanying cutaneous eruption.
   

SKIN. [46] [Crot. t.]
Sensation as if hide-bound.
Itching followed by painful burning.
Intense itching, > by very gentle scratching.
Scarlet redness of skin (with vesicles).
Redness, warmth, stinging here and there ; pustules running into one, oozing and forming a grey brown crust, which finally falls off.
Red moist spot, exuding offensive moisture, on left thigh opposite scrotum ; it is painfully sore to touch and on walking ; troublesome smarting when walking.
Itching and painful burning, with redness of skin ; formation of vesicles and pustules ; desiccation of pustules ; desquamation and falling off of pustules.
Eczema over whole body to soles of feet, with violent itching.
Pure idiopathic eczema, such as usually appears in children.
Herpetic eruption on scrotum.
Itching pustules.
Right face first affected, then left, or it may go downward, involving scrotum. θ Rhus poisoning.
